semiconductor_relevance: High — Hiro-Tec provides specialized equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in cleaning and fluid management.
summary: Hiro-Tec specializes in providing advanced cleaning and fluid management equipment for the semiconductor industry, including non-metallic diaphragm pumps and pure water heating systems. Their products are designed to enhance cleaning efficiency and support the miniaturization trends in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Non-metallic diaphragm pumps with automatic flow rate adjustment
Pure water heating equipment for energy-efficient cleaning processes
